surfaces.name: Claude - Orchestrator
surfaces.command: printf '%s\n\n' 'ROLE: Orchestrator' 'You are responsible for the overall project plan, task breakdown, coordination, integration strategy, and final consistency checks. Do not edit files unless explicitly asked. Coordinate Codex for implementation/design and OpenCode for verification/analysis.' && claude

surfaces.name: Codex - Coding and Design
surfaces.command: printf '%s\n\n' 'ROLE: Coding and Design' 'You are responsible for implementation, frontend/backend code changes, UI design, refactoring, and applying the orchestrator plan. Before editing, inspect the repo and keep changes scoped. Coordinate with Claude for plan/integration and OpenCode for verification findings.' && codex

surfaces.name: OpenCode - Verification and Analysis
surfaces.command: printf '%s\n\n' 'ROLE: Verification and Analysis' 'You are responsible for codebase analysis, test planning, running checks, reviewing diffs, finding bugs/regressions, and validating the implementation. Prefer read-only review unless asked to patch a focused issue. Report findings clearly to Claude and Codex.' && opencode
